title: Add REST/gRPC parity, socket hardening, and request audit tests

verification.cargo_test: cargo test -p microvm-contract-tests --test transport_parity — 11 tests passed, 0 failed
verification.workspace_tests: cargo test --workspace — all crates pass, 0 failures

backend: Both transports are backed by the SAME Arc<microvm_service::VmLifecycleService> (composed over a deterministic scripted LifecycleService inner double standing in for FirecrackerBackend — no KVM/root/Firecracker required). The supervised service owns all authorization, quota, idempotency, state mirroring, and audit; the tests only assert it, never duplicate or weaken it. Compile-time bound verified by vm_lifecycle_service_satisfies_both_transport_backends.

transport_drivers.rest: Raw HTTP/1.1 over tokio::net::UnixStream against microvm_rest::RestServer on a mode-0660 Unix socket; SO_PEERCRED maps the test process UID to a configured Principal via microvm_rest::peer::StaticAuthenticator.
transport_drivers.grpc: tonic MicrovmServiceClient (microvm_grpc::proto::v1) over a Unix-socket connector (tower::service_fn + hyper_util TokioIo) against microvm_grpc::GrpcServer; principal propagated via microvm_grpc::peer::StaticAuthenticator.
transport_drivers.parity_unit: Every operation reduces to a transport-neutral OpResult enum (Created/Started/Stopped/Snapshotted/Restored/Status/Metrics/Error{code}); parity is asserted on the service result, and Error carries the stable error_code identical across transports.

happy: GetVmStatus vm-512mib -> Status(created then running, spec 2/512/1024/none)
unauthorized: Viewer role: Create/Start/Stop/Snapshot -> permission_denied (REST 403 / gRPC PermissionDenied) + exactly one Denied audit event each
Cross-tenant (globex Owner) Start on acme vm -> permission_denied (REST 403 / gRPC PermissionDenied) + exactly one Denied audit event

audit_guarantee: assert_single_denied_event snapshots audit len before a single denied request and asserts len grew by exactly 1 with result=Denied and the correct Operation, for create/start/stop/snapshot via both role-denial (Viewer) and cross-tenant denial. Read-only status/metrics denials are not audited by the service (non-mutating), so they are exercised for error-code parity but not for audit count.

socket_policy.no_tcp_static_scan: Inline scanner mirrors the platform canonical FORBIDDEN_TCP_PATTERNS (0.0.0.0/127.0.0.1/tcp:///[::]/::1/localhost:) plus TcpListener/TcpSocket/TcpStream/to_socket_addrs across rest+grpc lib/config/server sources; positive control asserts UnixListener and serve_with_incoming.
socket_policy.tcp_runtime: tcp_config_fails_to_reach_the_api confirms the API is reachable only via the Unix socket and a loopback TCP connect (mirroring grpcurl -plaintext 127.0.0.1:50051) does not reach it.

mutation_sensitivity.rest_status_mutation: Temporarily mapping ErrorCode::PermissionDenied -> HTTP 404 made transport_status_and_code_mapping_agree fail (left 404 != right 403); reverted.
mutation_sensitivity.grpc_code_mutation: Temporarily mapping ErrorCode::PermissionDenied -> Code::NotFound made transport_status_and_code_mapping_agree fail; reverted.
mutation_sensitivity.adapters_unchanged: git status confirms only Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and the new crate changed; microvm-rest and microvm-grpc sources are unmodified (authorization neither duplicated nor weakened).

dependencies_note: Core deps per plan: microvm-types, microvm-errors, microvm-lifecycle, microvm-service, microvm-rest, microvm-grpc, tokio, serde_json, tempfile (all dev-dependencies; rest/grpc used as dev-dependencies). tonic/tower/hyper-util are added as dev-dependencies solely to drive the tonic-generated gRPC client over the Unix socket (versions match microvm-grpc); there is no other way to exercise the gRPC transport.
